formal_contract.scope: Classical SAT/Exact-One partial assignments, n<=240, max 4096 clauses and 24 literals per clause
formal_contract.SAT_forcing: Unit propagation only forces a literal when every other way of satisfying its clause is contradicted
formal_contract.EXACT_ONE_forcing: Each native Exact-One row's per-variable literal multiplicity is preserved; exact support reachability computed with integer bitset DP
formal_contract.failed_literal: Temporarily assign v=0 and v=1; only an actual propagated conflict can force the opposite value
formal_contract.quota: Selective failed-literal probing capped at 5% of total chargeable clause visits, plus at most one crossing visit. Aborted probe yields no inferred conflict.
formal_contract.complete_search: Both branch values remain reachable unless a logical contradiction is found; resource exhaustion is UNKNOWN
formal_contract.SAT_witness: Must pass independent UFR Boolean verifier
formal_contract.UNSAT_witness: n<=12 exhaustive independent check; n>12 requires separate C023/UFR portable certificate before external promotion
formal_contract.causal_consistency: PENROSE-003 strict DAG remains acyclic; optional hints are not an allowed FINAL_GATE->UFR_PRODUCE dependency

epistemic_ceiling: Global model consistency and forward-time partial-state consistency are ordinary formal algorithms
Lookahead forcing is standard failed-literal SAT search, not a new principle of causality
n220/240 test formulas are newly generated synthetic inputs, not historical unsolved CNFs from a NAS
Generated unsat cores do not produce portable third-party-verified UNSAT certificates in this experiment
UNKNOWN and failed proof time caps must be retained as negative/incomplete observations, not erased
Observed low-n slowdown means optimization not admitted to production C023
Retrocausal physical signaling NOT_ESTABLISHED, P vs NP OPEN
